part5.prompt: Movies are probably the most popular form of ___ in the United States.
part5.explanation: Sau “form of” cần danh từ “entertainment” (giải trí).
Thì hiện tại hoàn thành “has + V3” dùng “influenced” (đã ảnh hưởng).

part5.prompt: Actors can spend too much time ___ as well as too little.
part5.explanation: Cấu trúc “spend time doing something” cần V-ing “rehearsing” (diễn tập).

part5.prompt: Even when a show is ___, it is sometimes possible to get in.
part5.explanation: “Sold out” nghĩa là đã bán hết vé, phù hợp với “even when a show is …”.

part5.prompt: Orchestra music is wonderfully conducive to ___.
part5.explanation: “Conducive to” đi với danh từ/V-ing; “relaxation” là sự thư giãn.

part5.prompt: There is no good or bad music, only that which does or does not appeal to your ___.
part5.explanation: “Appeal to your taste” nghĩa là hợp gu/sở thích của bạn.

part5.prompt: New ___ are one of the most exciting aspects of museum work.
part5.explanation: Cần danh từ số nhiều “acquisitions” (hiện vật/tác phẩm mới được thu nhận) làm chủ ngữ.

part5.prompt: Sometimes I look at a famous painting and wonder why it is considered more ___ than the ones on either side of it.
part5.explanation: Sau “considered more” cần tính từ “significant” (có ý nghĩa/quan trọng hơn).

part5.prompt: The Internet ___ information faster than any other medium.
part5.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít “The Internet” đi với động từ hiện tại đơn “disseminates” (phổ biến).

part5.prompt: In any news medium, the only news is what the editor ___ is news.
part5.explanation: Chủ ngữ “the editor” số ít dùng “decides”.

part6.passage: Because of DVD players and cable TV, it is no longer necessary to leave home in search of ___. Families can watch movies in the comfort of their own living rooms. Nevertheless, going out to the movies is still a popular way to spend a weekend evening. Many people enjoy going to movie theaters because they like to see new movies as soon as they ___. They may also ___ to spend an evening out in public rather than quietly at home.

questions.explanation: Sau “in search of” cần danh từ “entertainment” (sự giải trí).
Phim được phát hành nên dùng bị động hiện tại đơn “are released” sau “as soon as”.
“Prefer to do something” nghĩa là thích làm điều gì hơn.

part6.passage: If you are looking for an activity that the whole family can enjoy, consider visiting one of our city’s fine museums. It is the perfect way to ___ fun with education. Depending on your family’s interests, you might ___ to visit a science, history, or art museum. If your children are older, they will want to visit exhibits that particularly interest them and take the time to give each one a ___ look. Younger children have a shorter attention span. Museums with interactive exhibits are best for them.

questions.explanation: “Combine fun with education” nghĩa là kết hợp vui chơi với giáo dục.
Sau động từ khuyết thiếu “might” cần nguyên mẫu “choose” (chọn).
“A thorough look” là một cái nhìn/xem xét kỹ lưỡng; cần tính từ “thorough”.

part6.passage: The new play, Sunflower Sunset, opened at the Westwood Playhouse last night. A lot of effort went into this production. The actors ___ for months, and an elaborate set was constructed. Unfortunately, this effort could not save the dull dialogue. It was easy to see that the ___ was bored—snoring was heard throughout the theater, and many people left before the end of the play. The actors made a fine effort with their ___, but the best acting in the world cannot save a poorly written play.

questions.explanation: Câu kể về hoạt động đã diễn ra trước đêm công diễn, dùng quá khứ đơn “rehearsed”.
“The audience” nghĩa là khán giả; họ chán đến mức ngáy và bỏ về giữa chừng.
Sau tính từ sở hữu “their” cần danh từ “performance” (phần biểu diễn).
